decode.name: code-like tokens after freetext stay freetext
inner spaces in freetext are kept
only one trailing line ending is removed
Arabic-Indic digits are not a code
D01 in freetext is not drill
pax with a space before the unit
pax inside a word is not decoded
pax of all zeros is not decoded
pax leading zeros before a long count
pax after a minus sign is not decoded
pax with Arabic-Indic digit is not decoded
gps integers are not a position
timestamp with colon and two-digit hour
duration bare number before a tab
duration bare number with decimal comma
duration decimal comma before a word
duration m is not a unit
